notes.subject: רכב
notes.rationale: 'Rider' (the upper stone that rides on the lower, so YLT) versus 'upper millstone' (KJV/JPS); I follow the millstone reading as most fit the pair רחים.

notes.subject: laip
notes.rationale: נפש here is livelihood/life itself — taking the millstones takes the means of grinding daily bread, i.e. a life.

notes.subject: רכב as millstone
notes.rationale: This sense of רכב (upper millstone) occurs only here in the Tanakh.

translation: No ken tekem tupela ston bilong penim graun, o ston antap bilong en, long sekuriti, bilong wanem, em i wanpela man i tekem laip long sekuriti.
